He co-wrote the songs for Disney's "Moana" soundtrack (2016) and is set to star in their upcoming film "Mary Poppins Returns".  Miranda's awards include a Pulitzer Prize, two Grammy Awards, an Emmy Award, a MacArthur Fellowship, and three Tony Awards.

It features original Survivor singer Dave Bickler on lead vocals.

Then it was recorded again by actress Gwyneth Paltrow for the movie "Country Strong" in which Paltrow stars.  Vince Gill and Patty Griffin also provide background vocals for the song.  The song is included on the movie's soundtrack that was released on October 26, 2010.

The song was part of the 1943 musical "The Gang's All Here" starring Alice Faye, James Ellison, and Carmen Miranda.  The movie cemented Miranda's image as the lady with the big fruity hats.
